title: 断断续续忙活一天，给博客换了面貌
summary: 笔者在将Hugo升级到 0.158.0后，使用原主题 hugo-theme-stack 构建站点时会弹出异常提示： WARN deprecated: css.Sass: libsass was deprecated in Hugo v0.153.0 and will be removed in a future release. Use dartsass instead. See https://gohugo.io/functions/
content:
笔者在将Hugo升级到 0.158.0后，使用原主题 hugo-theme-stack 构建站点时会弹出异常提示：

WARN deprecated: css.Sass: libsass was deprecated in Hugo v0.153.0 and will be removed in a future release. Use dartsass instead. See https://gohugo.io/functions/css/sass/#dart-sass

询问千问模型后，我才知晓Stack主题使用了LibSass编译器来处理样式，据说从Hugo的0.153.0版本就宣布弃用了。
